text: ざんねんだが　おまえの　でばんは　まったく　ねーぜ！

structure.jp: おまえの　でばんは

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が after a sentence joins it to a contrasting one, like 'but'. ざんねんだが = 'it's too bad, but'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ねー is a rough way to say ない ('there is none'), and ぜ adds a punchy tone. まったく　ねーぜ = 'there's none at all'.
